d: Giridih men upchunav ki tarikh ka elan bhale hi nahin huaa hai... lekin siyasi para abhi se charhne laga hai... BJP ne chunavi bisat bichhani shuru kar di hai... ilekshan Giridih By Election: incharj ki niyukti kar di gaee hai... to JMM ki taraph se kalpana soren ne morcha sanbhal liya hai... BJP ko modi ke nam par jit ka bharosa hai... to JMM divangat vidhayak sudivy kumar sonu ki virasat aur hemant sarkar ke kamkaj ko apni takat bata rahi hai... kangres bhi BJP ke davon par tanj kas rahi hai... yani tarikh ka intjar hai, lekin giridih men chunavi gadar abhi se shuru ho gaya hai...
